summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the Monthly P&L update (AUTO stock consumption, GRN purchases, Sales Invoice sales, Direct/Indirect expense record uploads, Gross Profit, comparison). Logged in as admin/admin123 on the preview URL, browser date 2026-10-17. All requested flows work and the UI values match a Python copy of computeAutoPnl (/app/tests/pnl_auto_check.py): Oct opening 68593250 (Sep's manual closing), purchase 5040192.63 from 39 GRNs, closing 91382041.08. Found 1 important business-logic issue (fake Oct profit from negative consumption when manual and AUTO months are mixed) and 1 precedence issue (expense records silently replace a manually entered expense). erp_state was snapshotted before testing and restored afterwards; the diff after restore is clean.
verified_working: Apr–Sep 2026 manual values unchanged (Sep 73323456/37083533/68593250/49115056/1933610/2935298) with reset links; Opening AUTO badge inherits previous month's closing
Oct 2026 shows pnl-purchase-auto-2026-10 and pnl-closing-auto-2026-10; Nov–Mar show 0
Clicking the purchase AUTO badge opens pnl-grn-modal: 39 GRNs, ₹50,40,192.63 excl GST
Typing 6000000 overrides purchase (Save (1)); after save and reload the value persists with a reset link; reset returns to AUTO 5040192.63
Opening override and reset back to 68593250 work
Created direct Sales Invoice AE-2026-001 (2 x 1000 + 500 freight) dated 2026-10-17: Oct sales becomes 2500 AUTO; pnl-ps-modal lists the invoice with taxable ₹2,500
Dispatching 2 units lowers Oct AUTO closing by 420 (2 x rate 210); deleting the invoice restores sales to 0 and closing to 91382041.08

Direct xlsx upload preview shows New x3, Invalid (no date), Duplicate in file; Excel date cell, yyyy-mm-dd and dd-mm-yyyy all parse; import adds 3 records; Nov direct becomes a button '₹2,83,000 3 items'
Re-uploading the same file marks every row 'Already uploaded' and disables 'Import 0 record(s)'
Indirect CSV upload works ('60,000' parsed; amount 0 marked Invalid); Oct indirect shows ₹85,000 2 items

Records modal: Edit + Save works; validation blocks amount 0; Download gives pnl-direct-expenses-2026-11.csv with correct rows; Delete (after confirm) 3 -> 2 and the cell total updates; FY Indirect Records list works; both templates download
P&L table: on all 12 rows Gross = Sales − Consumed − Direct, Net = Gross − Indirect, Total = Consumed + Ind + Dir; FY Total row equals the column sums
Comparison by month (Sep vs Oct) and by year (FY25-26 vs FY26-27) both show the Gross Profit metric
Negative consumed shows red 'negative — check Opening/Closing' text

Legacy Upload Stock Excel / Upload Expenses Excel buttons are present; legacy expense upload (Month/Type/Description/Amount) works and is added to new records in the same month (Dec 5000 + 7000 = 12000); trend charts render

ui_bugs.component: MonthlyPnL Oct 2026 (manual Sep closing + AUTO Oct closing)
ui_bugs.issue: Sep manual closing 68,593,250 carries into Oct opening, but Oct AUTO closing is the inventory valuation 91,382,041 (inventory-based Sep closing would be 86,383,777). Consumed = -17,748,598, which turns into a fake Oct Gross/Net profit of about ₹1.77 Cr, Profit % of 706627% (with sales 2500) and a big green Oct bar in the trend chart. FY 2026-27 totals are inflated by the same amount. The red warning shows, but the profit numbers stay misleading.

Uploading a record dated in a month that has a manual expense silently replaces the manual value. Sep direct 2,935,298 became ₹1,000 after a 1-row upload dated 2026-09-20, and Sep gross jumped from 43.66L to 73.00L. This conflicts with 'entered value wins'. Either add manual + records, or warn/confirm before replacing.

ui_bugs.component: Expense cell with both legacy lines and records
ui_bugs.issue: Dec direct shows '₹12,000 2 items' (1 legacy line + 1 record), but clicking it opens only the records modal (1 record, ₹7,000). The legacy line cannot be reached from that cell.
Negative money is shown as '₹-1,77,48,598.45' while the profit columns use 'Loss ₹…'. Inconsistent sign format.

issues: Uses the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the app's date component, while the Month column shows yyyy-mm

Year Opening and Closing Stock are sums of 12 monthly values (e.g. FY25-26 opening ₹74.7 Cr). For a year they should be the first month's opening and the last month's closing (pre-existing computeYear logic)

action_items: Decide how to handle mixed manual/AUTO months: e.g. when the previous month's closing is manual and the current closing is AUTO, use AUTO for the current opening too (or flag the gap), so a negative consumed does not show as profit; at least don't count negative consumed as profit in Gross/Net, % and charts
Expense precedence: either add manual + records, or confirm/warn before records replace an entered manual expense
When a month has both legacy lines and records, the expense cell click should show both
Format negative consumed and total expenses consistently (−₹ or a 'Negative' label)
Optional: year comparison should use the FY's first opening and last closing instead of sums
critical_code_review_comments: MonthlyPnL.tsx is about 1169 lines; split the stock table, P&L table, comparison and upload handlers into components
computeAutoPnl uses the browser's new Date() to pick the current month. A client clock or timezone mismatch can change which months are 'future'
moves.sort uses a.date.localeCompare; a GRN, issue or dispatch with a missing date throws and breaks the whole page. Guard with (a.date||'')
A manual value of 0 can't be entered for purchase/closing/sales because 0 means AUTO. If a month truly has 0 sales but invoices exist, it can't be overridden
Save stays enabled (Save (1)) after an override + reset returns the draft to the persisted values (no real change)
The closing AUTO badge is a <button> with no onClick (no drill-down, unlike purchase/sales)

success_rate.frontend: 95% of requested flows pass; 2 logic issues (1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM)

seed_data_creation: Temporary: Sales Invoice AE-2026-001 plus its dispatch (deleted via UI), TEST_ expense records Oct/Nov/Sep/Dec, legacy Dec expense lines, Oct monthlyPnl override. All removed by restoring the erp_state snapshot (/tmp/erp_full_snap.json); the diff after restore is clean.

The login inputs are name=amrest-login-username/password; navigate by clicking the 'Monthly P&L' and 'Sales Invoice' sidebar text. Direct invoice creation: new-invoice-btn > inv-mode-direct > inv-supply-type > inv-customer-select > inv-add-item > inv-item-0/qty/rate/freight > inv-save-btn. Browser date is 2026-10-17.
